$schema_note: User-visible product improvements, newest first. Feeds the pipeline's What's-new card and the homepage footer's latest-improvement stamp — one source, both surfaces (the homepage must match the real site). Keep entries honest, dated, and user-phrased; trim to ~12.

entries.title: The challenger learned the down-cycle classics
entries.blurb: Assumption challenges now overlay the discipline every crash re-teaches: market-driven leasing assumptions, worst-case drift, cash flow over exit hopes, and no credit for 'other buyers are circling'.

entries.title: Stale pages now fix themselves
entries.blurb: If your browser is showing an older copy of the site, it now notices the newer build and reloads itself once — no hard refresh needed, ever again.

entries.title: Every ticker figure is a door
entries.blurb: The dark price ticker's items — FMRs, rent caps, the 30-yr rate — now click through to the market behind them, with a caption saying what the band is.

entries.title: Market briefs open without an account
entries.blurb: Clicking a market in the homepage band used to hit a login wall. The 15 covered-market briefs — rules, rents, coverage — are now public; your own deal memory still needs a sign-in.

entries.title: The pipeline shows which deals sit in covered markets
entries.blurb: Each deal row now carries its covered-market name — same matcher the deal page uses — and searching the pipeline by market name finds those deals.

entries.title: The markets band runs on Why and the demo too
entries.blurb: The across-the-screen covered-markets band — every market a live link to its brief — now also anchors /why and introduces the demo's research layer. One shared implementation, three pages.

entries.title: The hero says what it's screening, one market at a time
entries.blurb: A rotating line under the headline cycles six covered markets with a real fact each — sourced FMRs and rules on file, straight from the research layer.

entries.title: The site names its own build — and the marquee navigates
entries.blurb: The footer stamps the exact commit the live site was built from (click it to see the code on GitHub), and every market in the marquee now links to its brief.

entries.title: The covered markets march across the homepage
entries.blurb: A second across-the-screen band — all 15 markets with a real fact each (sourced FMRs, rules on file), scrolling opposite the price ticker. The ticker itself now shows covered markets only.

entries.title: A What's-new log, everywhere you'd look
entries.blurb: This list — on the pipeline, at /whats-new, in the ⌘K palette, and stamped on the homepage — so improvements are never invisible again.

entries.title: Site freshness capped at ~10 minutes
entries.blurb: Browsers could show an hours-old copy of the site while revalidating. Now capped: what you see is at most minutes behind.

entries.title: One-tap market territories in the buy box
entries.blurb: Every covered market is a quick-add geography chip — a Dallas–Fort Worth chip matches Fort Worth and Plano deals too.
